title: Rush Processing Cost Kept on Cancelled Standard Endpoint Orders
content:
The rush processing a Hardware Procurement order is worked under starts on the day its quote is approved, and what it has cost is kept in the endpoint cancellation fee charged when a Standard Endpoint Order is cancelled after its purchase order:

- the order type's rush fee, **75.00 USD** for a Standard Endpoint Order, when the order was quoted with rush and its quote was approved at least one calendar day before the day the cancellation is recorded;
- half of it, **37.50 USD**, when such a quote was approved on that same day;
- nothing for an order quoted without rush.

The rush flag and the approval date are read from the cancelled order's own record.

| Quoted with rush | Quote approved | Kept in the endpoint cancellation fee |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | one or more calendar days before the cancellation day | 75.00 |
| Yes | on the cancellation day | 37.50 |
| No | any day | nothing |

**Boundary.** A quote approved on the day before the cancellation is one calendar day before it, and the whole rush fee is kept; a quote approved on the cancellation day itself keeps half.
